parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with mechanism of action classified as an activator. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_mechanism on molregno and filter drug_mechanism.action_type = 'ACTIVATOR'. Join target_dictionary to retrieve target details. Join compound_structures to obtain canonical SMILES. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, max_phase, mechanism_of_action, action_type, target_chembl_id, and target_name.
